description:
Here are Season 8’s sneakiest contraband hides seized at the border, where smugglers try to outsmart officers with some wild hiding spots. From AK-47 rifles hidden inside speaker cabinets in a carrier van to narcotics stuffed inside fuel tanks, floors, and tires, plus illegal seafood and guns and ammo concealed in car jump starters, officers uncover it all and many more.
#Discovery #ContrabandSeizedattheBorder

About Contraband: Seized at the Border
The border between the USA and Mexico is the busiest in the world. This series follows the work of America's Customs and Border Protection agency, whose job is to defend the border and stop terrorists, drugs and illegal weapons from entering the country.
